results.query: What is my current cumulative GPA and academic year?
results.sql: SELECT student_id, full_name, dept_code, year_of_study, cumulative_gpa FROM students WHERE student_id = 'STU-1001' LIMIT 100

results.query: Tell me my overall cumulative GPA and class standing.
results.sql: SELECT student_id, full_name, dept_code, year_of_study, cumulative_gpa FROM students WHERE student_id = 'STU-1001' LIMIT 100

results.query: What was Liam O'Connor's semester GPA in Fall 2026 versus his cumulative GPA?
results.sql: SELECT s.full_name, s.cumulative_gpa, g.term, g.semester_gpa FROM students s JOIN student_semester_gpas g ON s.student_id = g.student_id WHERE s.student_id = 'STU-1002' AND g.term = 'Fall 2026' LIMIT 100

results.query: How much do I still owe on my Fall 2026 fee ledger?
results.sql: SELECT fl.ledger_id, fl.term, fl.amount_due, fl.amount_paid, (fl.amount_due - fl.amount_paid) AS remaining_balance, fl.status FROM fee_ledger fl WHERE fl.student_id = 'STU-1002' AND fl.term = 'Fall 2026' LIMIT 100

results.query: What is my remaining unpaid balance in the fee ledger for Fall 2026?
results.sql: SELECT fl.ledger_id, fl.term, (fl.amount_due - fl.amount_paid) AS remaining_balance, fl.status FROM fee_ledger fl WHERE fl.student_id = 'STU-1002' AND fl.term = 'Fall 2026' LIMIT 100

results.query: List my enrolled courses and class timetable for Fall 2026.
results.sql: SELECT e.course_id, c.title, t.day_of_week, t.start_time, t.end_time, t.room, t.building FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id JOIN timetable t ON e.course_id = t.course_id AND e.term = t.term WHERE e.student_id = 'STU-1001' AND e.term = 'Fall 2026' ORDER BY e.course_id, t.day_of_week LIMIT 100

results.query: Which courses am I taking this semester and what rooms are they in?
results.sql: SELECT e.course_id, t.day_of_week, t.start_time, t.room, t.building FROM enrollments e JOIN timetable t ON e.course_id = t.course_id AND e.term = t.term WHERE e.student_id = 'STU-1001' AND e.term = 'Fall 2026' ORDER BY e.course_id, t.day_of_week LIMIT 100

results.query: Which open research grants in the database match a 3rd-year CS student with a 3.74 GPA?
results.sql: SELECT grant_id, grant_name, dept_code, min_gpa, min_year, max_year, award_amount, deadline FROM grants WHERE status = 'open' AND deadline >= '2026-11-23' AND (dept_code = 'CS' OR dept_code = 'ALL') AND min_gpa <= 3.74 AND 3 BETWEEN min_year AND max_year ORDER BY grant_id LIMIT 100

results.query: What is the database deadline and award amount for GR-CS-02?
results.sql: SELECT grant_id, grant_name, deadline, award_amount FROM grants WHERE grant_id = 'GR-CS-02' LIMIT 100

results.query: Which CS faculty mentors are currently accepting undergraduate researchers?
results.sql: SELECT mentor_id, faculty_name, research_area, office_room FROM faculty_mentors WHERE dept_code = 'CS' AND accepting_undergrads = TRUE ORDER BY mentor_id LIMIT 100

results.query: Is Dr. Hannah Sato accepting undergrads in Mechanical Engineering right now?
results.sql: SELECT faculty_name, dept_code, accepting_undergrads, office_room FROM faculty_mentors WHERE faculty_name = 'Dr. Hannah Sato' AND dept_code = 'ME' LIMIT 100

results.query: How many applications have already been submitted for GR-CS-01?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS application_count, MAX(application_id) AS application_id, MAX(decision_status) AS decision_status FROM grant_applications WHERE grant_id = 'GR-CS-01' LIMIT 100

results.query: What was the total disbursed for GR-CS-01 in fiscal year 2025?
results.sql: SELECT grant_id, fiscal_year, total_disbursed, recipients_count, archived_deadline FROM grant_history WHERE grant_id = 'GR-CS-01' AND fiscal_year = 2025 LIMIT 100

results.query: What is the published base tuition and lab fee for an in-state CS student?
results.sql: SELECT fee_schedule_id, dept_code, residency_status, term, base_tuition, lab_fee, health_fee FROM fees WHERE dept_code = 'CS' AND residency_status = 'in_state' AND term = 'Fall 2026' LIMIT 100

results.query: Do I have any approved fee waivers for Fall 2026?
results.sql: SELECT waiver_id, waiver_type, waiver_amount, status, approved_by FROM fee_waivers WHERE student_id = 'STU-1001' AND term = 'Fall 2026' LIMIT 100

results.query: When does Final Examinations Week start in Fall 2026?
results.sql: SELECT event_id, term, event_name, event_date FROM academic_calendar WHERE event_name = 'Final Examinations Week' AND term = 'Fall 2026' LIMIT 100

results.query: Which research labs require safety clearance?
results.sql: SELECT lab_id, lab_name, dept_code, pi_name, building, safety_clearance_required FROM research_labs WHERE safety_clearance_required = TRUE ORDER BY lab_id LIMIT 100

results.query: Who is my academic advisor and what is my enrollment status?
results.sql: SELECT student_id, full_name, advisor_name, enrollment_status FROM students WHERE student_id = 'STU-1011' LIMIT 100

results.query: Which legacy scholarships were discontinued between 2021 and 2023?
results.sql: SELECT archive_id, legacy_code, title, discontinued_year, old_min_gpa FROM scholarships_archive WHERE discontinued_year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 ORDER BY archive_id LIMIT 100

results.query: Who are the faculty reviewers assigned to GR-ECE-01?
results.sql: SELECT reviewer_id, grant_id, faculty_name, dept_code, review_round FROM grant_reviewers WHERE grant_id = 'GR-ECE-01' LIMIT 100

results.query: What is the total annual grant pool across all departments?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(annual_grant_pool) AS total_annual_grant_pool FROM departments LIMIT 100

results.query: List all students who made the Dean's List in Fall 2026.
results.sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.full_name, g.term, g.semester_gpa, g.deans_list_flag FROM student_semester_gpas g JOIN students s ON s.student_id = g.student_id WHERE g.term = 'Fall 2026' AND g.deans_list_flag = TRUE ORDER BY s.student_id LIMIT 100

results.query: What student awards has Sofia Alvarez received?
results.sql: SELECT a.award_id, s.full_name, a.award_title, a.awarded_term, a.stipend_amount FROM student_awards a JOIN students s ON s.student_id = a.student_id WHERE s.full_name = 'Sofia Alvarez' LIMIT 100

results.query: Which courses in Computer Science are taught at the 400 level?
results.sql: SELECT course_id, title, credits, course_level, instructor_name FROM courses WHERE dept_code = 'CS' AND course_level = 400 ORDER BY course_id LIMIT 100
